title: Broadcast-scope @-mentions (@everyone, @here, @admins)
description:
Formalize broadcast-scope @-mentions in JMAP Chat. The current Mention type and rich-body `"mention"` span are per-user only (carry a ChatContact.id); there is no wire format for broadcast-scope mentions. The `mention_all` permission exists but only as a send-side gate without a corresponding mention type.

This epic adds three broadcast scopes:
- `@everyone` — all current Space/Chat members
- `@here` — currently-active members (server-defined "active" semantic)
- `@admins` — members with administrative permissions (server-defined "admin" semantic)

Trimmed from the initial proposal:
- `@all` — synonym for `@everyone`; drop
- `@user` — already exists as the per-user mention
- `@user@host` and `@{did}` — split into separate epics

This is real feature work that touches four documents (main draft, push draft, federation draft, push platform guide). The work decomposes into one design-decisions bead and four implementation beads. Design decisions land first; implementation beads are parallel after that.
